title: Shortfall mitigation rotations and SKU burn model
body:
Shortfall Mitigation Rotations & SKU Burn Model — operational worksheet

Objective:
- Maintain production SLOs (95th pct latency guardrails) across hosted and dedicated fleets while managing constrained supply and variable lead times.
- Provide a prioritized order pipeline and a rotation playbook to stretch available accelerators for the next 120 days.

Executive summary:
- Current blended fleet utilization: 78% (global). Target steady-state utilization: 70% to maintain headroom for bursts.
- Critical shortfall window projected: 2025-01 through 2025-04 based on bids and supplier lead-time drift. (See Orders in pipeline)
- Top mitigation levers: workload routing to cheaper/older SKUs, burst-to-dedicated throttles, aggressive KV/prefix caching, and prioritized SKU orders per region.

Key assumptions:
- Monthly burn rate measured in GPU-months (1 GPU-month = 730 GPU-hours).
- Workload mix: inference (75% of tokens), embeddings (15%), experiments/finetune (10%).
- Region split: us-west-2 45%, eu-west-1 30%, ap-northeast-1 25%.
- Lead-time buckets (supplier commitments as of 2024-11-10): short 4-6 weeks, medium 8-12 weeks, long 16-26 weeks.

Inventory snapshot (2024-11-10):
SKU | Logical units | Region pref (units) | Age (avg months) | On-hand burn-days @ current load
A100-80GB | 1,150 | us-west-2 (520), eu-west-1 (380), ap-northeast-1 (250) | 18 | 42
H100 | 420 | us-west-2 (220), eu-west-1 (120), ap-northeast-1 (80) | 6 | 31
L4 (inference optimized) | 300 | us-west-2 (100), eu-west-1 (100), ap-northeast-1 (100) | 2 | 27
T4 (legacy) | 220 | us-west-2 (60), eu-west-1 (90), ap-northeast-1 (70) | 36 | 14

Notes on inventory: older T4s have lower throughput for modern large context workloads; keep for cheap background jobs and experiments. A100s are our workhorse for mid-size contexts, H100 prioritized for high-peak customers and quantized large-context workloads.

Monthly GPU-month burn model (conservative forecast):
Month | Projected GPU-months needed | Expected arrivals | Net change
2024-12 | 1,150 | +200 (orders landing) | -950
2025-01 | 1,300 | +80 (partial) | -1,220
2025-02 | 1,420 | +60 | -1,360
2025-03 | 1,380 | +200 (staggered) | -1,180
2025-04 | 1,300 | +300 | -1,000

Interpretation: If arrival schedule slips by two weeks for the medium tranche, deficit widens by ~6–8% per month.

Orders in pipeline (operational tracker):
PO | SKU | Qty | Supplier | ETA window | Priority | Notes
PO-2209 | A100-80GB | 300 | Supplier-X | 2024-12-08 to 2024-12-22 | high | partial pre-pay done, _pending customs clearance leadtime confirmation_
PO-2217 | H100 | 180 | Supplier-Y | 2025-01-04 to 2025-02-28 | urgent | staggered shipment; vendor indicated medium lead-time but allocation not final
PO-2244 | L4 | 200 | Cloud-Reseller | 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-21 | medium | flexible delivery to regions based on demand
PO-2268 | A100-80GB (refurb) | 150 | Secondary-Dealer | 2025-02-15 to 2025-03-10 | low | lower throughput; contingency units only

Prioritization decision matrix (how we rank incoming/available units):
1) Latency-critical paid customers -> must match to H100/A100; never schedule on T4.
2) Dedicated reserved pools -> honor contract SLA; use A100 first, fallback to H100 if capacity and latency favorable.
3) Hosted best-effort inference -> can be routed to L4/T4 where model-quantization and batching keeps quality acceptable.
4) Background experiments/finetune -> route aggressively to refurb/older SKUs or spot instances.

Rotation playbook (30/60/90 day operations):
- 0–30 days (emergency):
  - Apply burst-throttle: limit new non-SLA token issuance by 15% via rate-limiter flags in gateway. Ticket: INFRA-urgent-rate-limit.
  - Re-route embedding-only jobs to L4 pool by tagging embeddings routes. Owner: Lina.
  - Hold non-critical scheduled finetunes; offer credits to customers who reschedule.
- 30–60 days (stretch):
  - Start cross-region burst routing: move best-effort jobs from us-west-2 to ap-northeast-1 where L4 headroom exists.
  - Spin up temporary quantized A100 variants for mid-size workloads (quant profile Q3).
  - Validate KV caching settings: increase persistent-prefix cache TTL by 30% for stable customers.
- 60–90 days (re-balance):
  - Execute SKU rebalancing shipments: prioritize moving newly arrived A100s to eu-west-1 to relieve queue backlog. Logistics owner: Marco.
  - Decommission worst-performing T4s from serving path; migrate to dev-only cluster.

Decision triggers and thresholds:
- If regional utilization > 85% for 3 consecutive days -> escalate to SRE on-call and enact emergency throttle.
- If supplier ETA slips > 14 days beyond committed ETA for any medium tranche -> downgrade priority of non-contracted POs and re-route orders to secondary suppliers.
- If customer-impacting latency regressions observed for >5% of requests -> immediate rollback of quantization/pack heuristics on affected routes.

Quick actions (next 14 days):
- Confirm customs clearance window for PO-2209 (Samir).
- Run region-level stress test on L4 pool with 10% synthetic load (Erin).
- Draft customer comms for potential brief capacity throttles (Product Ops + CS).

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: supplier allocation re-prioritization -> Mitigation: maintain secondary dealer list and negotiate 30% refundable deposit to lock allocation.
- Risk: regional demand spike due to partner launch -> Mitigation: pre-approve emergency burst credits and reserve 5% global spare capacity for partner launches.
- Risk: extended lead times on H100 -> Mitigation: increase A100 quantized profile usage; push H100 to only top-tier contracts.

Appendix A — burn-rate math (sample):
- Current global GPU-hours per day = 78% util * total_on_hand_gpus * 24 hours.
- Example: total_on_hand_gpus = 2,090 -> hours/day = 0.78 * 2,090 * 24 = 39,076 GPU-hours/day -> GPU-months = 39,076 * 30 / 730 ≈ 1,605 GPU-months.

Appendix B — notes and open questions:
- Confirm lead-time buckets with Supplier-Y sales engineer (Marco) — ask for lot-level ETA.
- Evaluate short-term rental market for H100 in APAC (vendor list in linked_artifacts).
- Need an ops runbook entry for automated route-switching when a region crosses 85% sustained utilization.
